findings.description: Offscreen transition restores coordinates/anchor only, then placed=false. When it returns, Refresh saves current compact font7/8 as original size, so OFF cannot restore original font10. Restore does not restore original colour after layout gray-mutes old captions.
findings.requested_check: Visible font10/colour -> layout -> offscreen -> visible -> OFF retains font10 and logical colour. Extend native restoration assertions beyond time/price/text.
findings.resolution: Both cached and refreshed offscreen transitions call full Restore. Restore now writes logical font, colour, anchor, text and tooltip before placed=false. Refresh tracks last rendered font/colour, so own compact styles do not overwrite logical style during repeated reflow. Source path review resolves original issue; separate native lifecycle assertion remains required for runtime proof.
